paper_evidence: Complete for the explicitly narrowed small-width LUT-only arithmetic resynthesis claim and fixed declared matrix; adequate to organize a scoped research manuscript, not universal superiority or a guarantee of publication.
tvlsi_readiness: NOT_ESTABLISHED: three related MAC configurations, one FPGA family and one error budget per width; final strong-control gains are modest and application quality is not uniformly superior. No assertion that evidence completion alone meets a venue threshold.

claim_decisions.claim: Increment beyond the tested independent-support/QUADOL serial control
claim_decisions.evidence: 9-bit and10-bit core LUT69→66 and64→62;8-bit52→52. All same declared WCE bound and clock; this does not exclude every possible serial algorithm.

claim_decisions.claim: Controller-inclusive equal-work resource gain at fixed clock
claim_decisions.evidence: Three16-term kernels: best measured baseline107/121/125→103/118/123 LUT;3.74/2.48/1.60%; FF/CARRY4 unchanged within each width,15ns target passed.
Current relation, nonconstantI5 and numerical freedom each have controlled ablation evidence; individual components tie on some cases.

claim_decisions.claim: Better resource AND application quality than every baseline
claim_decisions.evidence: Serial control has higher pooled PSNR in all six width/task summaries. Main spends some accuracy for lower integrated LUT.8-bit exact-output mode has same core LUT and better accuracy than full mode.

claim_decisions.claim: Universal scalable synthesis, end-to-end speedup, energy improvement or TVLSI acceptance
claim_decisions.evidence: Full-domain search remains exponential, single-device OOC implementation, no board/power/maximum-frequency study; venue competitiveness not inferred from completion.

limitations: All final MACs have24active inputbits; larger dot-product vectors demonstrate modular composition only.
LUT-only Artix7 scope; no claim of superiority when DSP use is unrestricted.
QUADOL uses a common WCE adapter, not the original MRED/nMSE evaluation; serial control is not a full ASPDAC2017 ILP reproduction.
Two author baseline reruns differ due to string-set ordering. Exact frozen graphs/RTL and both rounds are retained; main and ablation canonical RTL are identical toR18.
Original primary evidence_hashes.json is a stage snapshot; expected serial progress updates are reconciled separately and final ZIP manifest verifies delivered bytes.
